simulation_design.error_unit: unique staging event keyed by individual_id, year, segment
simulation_design.shared_event_error: same event error reused when an event is destination of one transition and origin of the next
simulation_design.within_individual_year_error_process: stationary Gaussian AR1 across ordered staging events
simulation_design.point_estimator: exact OLS point slope for frozen wigeon controller design; lambda_hat=1+beta_origin_phase
simulation_design.extrapolation: quadratic mean-lambda curve evaluated at zeta=-1

scenarios.name: era5_complete_equal_independent_replicates_rho0
scenarios.origin: SD(ERA5_phase-POWER_phase)/sqrt(2) from complete 256-event source-faithful ERA5 calibration

scenarios.name: era5_complete_discrepancy_correlation_proxy
scenarios.origin: equal-replicate SD plus observed consecutive ERA5-minus-POWER discrepancy correlation

scenarios.name: era5_complete_conservative_full_disagreement_rho0
scenarios.origin: entire ERA5-minus-POWER disagreement SD treated as each-event error

claim_boundary: SIMEX v2 is conditional on error scales from the complete 256-event POWER-versus-ERA5 replicate calibration.
The calibration is complete but does not identify a gold-standard source-specific error distribution.
The equal-independent-replicate interpretation and correlation proxy are assumptions, not direct latent-error identification.
The conservative full-disagreement scenario deliberately over-assigns replicate disagreement to each source.
SIMEX-extrapolated values are sensitivity diagnostics and are not promoted as the true latent biological lambda.
No scenario, seed, zeta grid or extrapolation rule may be changed after SIMEX v2 results are opened.
The registered Aikens analysis remains unchanged and unopened.
